PaymentRepositoryIntegrationTest 5 passed, including updateTest. PaymentsProcessingApiIntegrationTest: testGetPaymentStatus_400 passed; testGetPaymentStatus_201 failed (left failing, T-14).
MODEL: no model lines.
CHOICES: updateTest writes and asserts Instant.parse("2026-10-14T10:00:00Z"), the fixed test now in the data.sql header, on every timestamp. A whole second survives microsecond truncation. saveTest still calls Instant.now() and does not compare it; it passed. testGetPaymentStatus_400 now sends {"orderId": null}. The generated body {"orderId": "orderId-w9m"} is a valid string, GetPaymentStatusInputDTO.orderId is @NotNull, and the controller returns 201 for any body that passes validation, so a valid body cannot be 400. The WebTestClient sends HTTP basic admin/password from application.yml. Security runs before bean validation; without it the call is 401 and the 400 case never runs. That also lets testGetPaymentStatus_201 reach the handler.
NOT CHECKED: full suite. testGetPaymentStatus_201 left as generated. It returns 201 with outcome, noPayment and started all null, and fails on the first assertion, $.outcome isNotEmpty (PaymentsProcessingApiIntegrationTest.java:38). The same test still expects noPayment and started both set. No mapper edits.
